description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service.

description.zh: 镜像升级任务的信息。可调用[DescribeFotaTasks](~~437001~~)获取该参数。
description.en: The ID of the image update task. You can call the [DescribeFotaTasks](~~437001~~) operation to obtain the value of this parameter.

description.zh: 设置镜像升级任务是否自动推送。
description.en:
Specifies whether to automatically push the image update task.

Valid values:

- Running: automatically pushes the image update task.

- Pending: does not automatically push the image update task.

title.zh: 为镜像升级任务打开或关闭自动推送

descriptions.zh: 本接口用于控制每个镜像升级任务的独立开关，仅当镜像升级功能模块的全局自动升级开关被关闭时生效。若全局自动升级开关被打开，则每个镜像升级任务的开关均始终保持打开。如需打开或关闭该全局自动升级开关，请前往无影云电脑控制台的**运维\>镜像升级**页面。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation to manage each image update task. This operation is valid only when the auto-update switch in the image update module for global image updates is turned off. If the auto-update switch is turned on, the switches for each image update task are always turned on. If you want to turn on or off the auto-update switch, go to the Elastic Desktop Service console and choose **Operations > Image Updates** in the left-side navigation pane.
